acceptanceCriteria: Archived but unclosed Work Items expose explicit finalize or cleanup and close next actions in machine status and human Outcome; they remain non-green and ordinary start/new remains fail closed.
A valid merged PR with a deleted branch and removed worktree reaches close only through identity-bound finalization evidence; missing or retained resources cannot be silently closed.
Release adopter and upgrade harnesses remove their private run roots on success and failure after writing acceptance artifacts; test wrappers also clean temporary outputs without deleting truth.
Regression tests cover cleanup omission visibility, start/new blocking, failure-path cleanup, and isolation of HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME TMPDIR and CARGO_HOME.
English Simplified Chinese and Japanese documentation describe the same repository/adopter cleanup boundary; no source fallback or global current-project state is introduced.
goal: 让每个仓库在 Work Item 结束时获得明确的 cleanup handoff 与 fail-closed readiness；发布 adopter harness 不留下临时运行根目录。
intent: 根治对象工程遗漏 finalize、close、分支和工作树清理的生命周期缺口，并确保发布验收临时环境在成功和失败路径都可证明清理。
outOfScope: provider API 自动删除分支或工作树
全局 Agent 或 MCP 配置
